```artifact
Feature: Database and System Requirements

  Scenario: 3 year database with 4.0 Million Consultation requests
    Given a 3 year database
    When 4.0 Million Consultation requests are made
    Then the system should be able to handle the requests without errors

  Scenario: System design for 4.0 Million Consultation requests
    Given a system designed to handle 4.0 Million Consultation requests
    When 4.0 Million Consultation requests are made
    Then the system should be able to handle the requests without errors

  Scenario: 250,000 unique Patients provisioning
    Given 250,000 unique Patients are provisioned
    When the system is used by the Patients
    Then the system should be able to handle the Patients without errors

  Scenario: System support for up to 5 specialities
    Given the system supports up to 5 specialities
    When the system is used for 5 specialities
    Then the system should be able to handle the specialities without errors

  Scenario: System design for future growth
    Given the system is designed for future growth
    When the system is used for an extended period
    Then the system should be able to handle the growth without errors

  Scenario: System capability for mobile platform (android)
    Given the system is capable of running on a mobile platform (android)
    When the system is used on an android device
    Then the system should be able to run without errors

  Scenario: Adaptive user interface design
    Given the user interface is designed for adaptive response
    When the system is used by different users
    Then the system should be able to adapt to the users without errors

  Scenario: Usability of the system
    Given the system is designed for usability
    When the system is used by different users
    Then the system should be easy to use without errors

  Scenario Outline: System performance with different values
    Given a system with <number> unique Patients and <number> specialities
    When <number> Consultation requests are made
    Then the system should be able to handle the requests without errors

    Examples:
      | number | number | number |
      | 200,000 | 3     | 2,000,000 |
      | 250,000 | 4     | 3,000,000 |
      | 300,000 | 5     | 4,000,000 |
```
